summary: joule-btp-extension: install-time host/file harvest with POST exfiltration and virtualenv bin write
details: setup.py, when executed by pip (guarded on PIP_BUILD_TRACKER/PIP_REQ_TRACKER environment variables), collects the installer's hostname, selected environment variables (HOME, USER, PATH, VIRTUAL_ENV, etc.), reads /private/etc/passwd and /etc/hosts, recursively globs the current working directory and $VIRTUAL_ENV reading file contents, and POSTs a JSON report to a hardcoded URL (http://127.0.0.1:4445/collect in this release). The same install-time code writes a marker file to $VIRTUAL_ENV/bin/.joule-btp-extension-was-here, demonstrating executable-path write into the installer's active virtualenv. The module docstring self-identifies as a supply-chain proof-of-concept; the loopback destination is placeholder infrastructure, but the harvest-and-exfiltrate dataflow and the bin-directory write are fully wired and fire automatically on pip install.
